timing: written before scene build and first physics step
hypothesis: Real Panda and mobile Stretch; assign contacts and withdraw both at the end.
goal: Rotate freely resting disc, keep centre bounded, withdraw and settle for 2 s

high_level.goal: Observe and stabilize the initial scene
Rotate using measured heading and contact response
If needed unload, relocate and establish another contact
Withdraw and satisfy independent stable-release criteria

low_level.exit: selected approach reached; intended touch up to 2 N allowed; no unintended collision
measured intended contact above acquisition threshold
local progress, measured slip, or working-sector boundary
next measured approach pose reachable and clear
all robot and aid contact unloaded

action_interface: bounded robot joint effort only; no object pose/velocity/force writes after reset
failure_policy: Stop on physical violation; retain failed and truncated attempts; failure is not global infeasibility
